name: fisher
desc: FRAMING: close half-body portrait cropped at the waist, head and shoulders filling most of the frame — not a full-length figure. A river fisher in his thirties with a squinting neutral expression from a lifetime of looking at water: lean face, wind-burnt cheekbones, black hair cut short and salted at the temples, a thin white scar across one knuckle. He wears a deep slate-teal oilskin smock with the hood pushed back, a knitted grey-blue jumper underneath, a net-needle on a cord round his neck, and a folded length of net over one shoulder. Damp, practical, unbothered by the weather.
